🤖 **Agent note** · filed
- **Agent:** new-issue-creator job (new-issue-creator-code-b)
- **Session / ID:** cron new-issue-creator-code-b run 2026-11-05 13:50 CST
- **Found via:** filed this run
- **Task:** Filed this issue — Meta keeper re-arm is all-or-nothing: a partial `.backup` unit rename is never restored and the `exporter-missing` alert falsely claims no `.backup` copies exist (meta-renewal.ts:111/:114/:232-233). Verified with the real module on the laptop (probe ~/git/fleet/probe-meta-partial): both partial states → exporter-missing + false alert, no restore; both-backups control restored correctly.
- **Expectation:** effort s — per-unit restore in `defaultEnsureExporterArmed`, accurate alert text, and tests that exercise the default implementation against a fake unit dir; done when the acceptance criteria on the issue pass.
- **Links:** queue packet enqueued to repo-health-code-pilot this run
<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=new-issue-creator-code-b state=filed at=2026-11-05T20:20:00Z -->

🤖 **Agent note** · triaged — confirmed, fix routed
- **Agent:** repo queue worker, lane code-c (repo-worker-code)
- **Session / ID:** cron repo-queue-worker-shift-c run 2026-11-05 14:03 CST; task 10743 (triage, direct lane)
- **Task:** task 10743 — triage of issue #6366.
- **Fresh verification (2026-11-05 ~20:10Z, laptop primary main 7d5d64f940, read-only):** `pm-stack/aggregator/src/meta-renewal.ts` `defaultEnsureExporterArmed` still has the all-or-nothing shape the issue describes — returns `armed` only when the timer AND service both exist; restores only when the timer `.backup` AND service `.backup` both exist; every mixed state falls through to `missing`. The `exporter-missing` alert text still states "no .backup copies exist" unconditionally for that result. `src/meta-renewal.test.ts` injects `ensureExporterArmed` in all 6 tests (lines 38, 56, 70, 82, 105, 118), so the default filesystem implementation has no coverage. This matches the creator's probe results in the issue body (partial-backup states for each unit reproduce: no restore, false alert). No hard-stop labels on issue #6366; no competing PR found in the packet refs.
- **Decision:** CONFIRMED as filed. Fix is scoped exactly per the acceptance criteria: per-unit restore in `defaultEnsureExporterArmed`, `exporter-missing` only when no unit and no `.backup` exists (mixed states name the actual per-unit state), and new tests exercising the default implementation against a fake unit directory. Enqueued as a `small_fix` follow-up task (see Links) — this triage task completes as `triaged`.
- **Links:** task 10743 · issue #6366 · related issue #6079, issue #6120
